description:
Hundreds of dachshunds strutted their tiny legs down the iconic Champs-Elysees, delighting onlookers as the 'Sausage Walk' celebrated its 2026 edition with colorful costumes, wagging tails, and French flair.

Protesters camp out in Madrid's downtown square, Puerta del Sol, to demand political action to tackle a housing crisis. Spanish police arrested three members of a far-right group and fired rubber bullets on the night of October 3 in the capital, after tens of thousands had marched across the country to protest the housing crisis.
